description: Sends a new recovery account to the institution's panel counsel as a written brief — borrower, claim amount, security position, preferred forum, a summary of up to 1,200 characters and the documents available. The brief is emailed to the firm (legal@unifiedchambers.com, with a copy to the Senior Partner’s mailbox), entered in the firm’s panel register where one is kept, and an acknowledgement is emailed to the signed-in address. Use when the institution wants to instruct its panel counsel on a new account.

borrower.description: Name of the borrower or principal debtor (company or individual).

claim_inr.description: Amount claimed or outstanding, in rupees (for example 25000000 for ₹2.5 crore).

documents_available.description: Documents in hand, if known: sanction letter, loan agreement, security documents, statement of account, notices.

forum_preference.description: Preferred route or forum, if any: DRT original application, SARFAESI enforcement, IBC, arbitration, civil suit or Section 138 complaint.

security.description: 'secured' (mortgage, hypothecation or another security interest), 'unsecured', or 'mixed' (partly secured).

summary.description: The account in up to 1,200 characters: facility, default, notices already issued, security and anything urgent.

name: brief_new_matter
title: Brief a new matter
